letsfg.description: Flight and hotel search & booking for AI agents. Server-side engine covers hundreds of airlines with per-flight reliability history, plus real bookable hotel rates with free cancellation and pay-later terms. Hotel booking charges a 5% non-refundable reservation fee; the balance is paid to the supplier by balance_due_by. Set LETSFG_API_KEY to reach both flights and hotels, or LETSFG_BEARER_TOKEN (from `letsfg auth`) for free flight-only access — set one, not both.
